EP.numerator: Most recently publicly reported net profit excluding non-recurring gains/losses; exact primary Wind item NET_PROFIT_AFTER_DED_NR_LP
EP.denominator: Prior month-end A-share raw closing price times TOT_SHR; paper footnote includes B/H shares in this valuation denominator
EP.frequency_does_not_define_profit_period: Quarterly reporting after 2002 does not establish a single-quarter numerator. TTM, YTD/cumulative, annual or single-quarter interpretation remains unqualified in the examined passages. Do not silently substitute inverse PE_TTM.
EP.ownership_attribution_not_silently_added: Primary item is not additionally asserted to be attributable-to-parent earnings merely from an abbreviated field name.
EP.fallback: Only if primary adjusted-profit item is absent: NET_PROFIT_EXCL_MIN_INT_INC, net profit excluding minority-interest income; this is a separate fallback, not zero fill.
EP.statement_priority: Online appendix lists STATEMENT_TYPE 408005000, then 408001000; this alone does not establish historical restatement availability.

sample_and_sorting.original_sample: 2000-01 to 2016-12; Shanghai/Shenzhen main boards and GEM, prefixes 60/30/00, financial firms included
sample_and_sorting.exclusions: Less than six months listed; fewer than 120 trading observations in prior year or 15 in latest month; then smallest 30% by prior month-end ME. Do not replace with current survivors or current HS300.
sample_and_sorting.sorts: Remaining universe: ME median S/B, independent EP 30/70 thresholds, six value-weighted portfolios. VMG=(S/V+B/V-S/G-B/G)/2.
